name: Janitor
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve bandana, beaded locs, navy workwear, yellow gloves/caddy and string mop. Review one mop's continuous motion, clear attack reversal, opaque warm foam with cyan gaps, face/title and cyan keying around cleaning bottles.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Janitor — Turn It Around.
IDENTITY: exact athletic adult brown-skinned man with black locs tied high and gold beads, dark patterned bandana, short goatee, gold earrings and chains. Navy work coveralls over a white hooded shirt, rolled white cuffs, bright yellow rubber gloves, yellow utility harness/belt, blank ID badge, white-black-yellow sneakers, yellow cleaning caddy with fist hazard emblem, spray bottles and white rag. Preserve his long wooden-handled mop with black grips and thick off-white cotton strings.
0–0.7s: full-body wide stance. A huge isolated charcoal sludge comet rushes in from deep perspective toward a small floating gold fist charm beside him. He raises the mop across its path with a calm sideways look.
0.7–2.5s: the mop strings fan out like an enormous catcher's mitt and CATCH the sludge comet. Its momentum swings him through one dramatic full-body pivot. Camera pulls sharply back to reveal the huge circular sweep of the mop. In the SAME uninterrupted swing the cotton strings wring the dark sludge into dense clean ivory foam, reversing its direction. He slings the transformed comet back into the distance as a much larger gleaming cream-and-gold cleansing wave; the little gold charm beside him shines brighter as the wave departs. One explosive finite ivory impact bloom on the reversal, hard readable contact beat, no screen-covering flash. The mop handle stays connected and anatomically controlled in his two gloved hands.
2.5–3.5s: whip-camera follows the departing clean wave, then snaps back to his composed face. Exact title TURN IT AROUND slams below his chin with a heavy swiping impact. Mop strings recoil to their normal size and hang from the same wooden handle.
3.5–5s: full-body hero hold, mop resting diagonally across his stance and all unoccupied areas pure cyan. One tiny dirty drop falls toward his spotless sneaker; without looking he nudges the yellow caddy under it, catching it with a single PLIP. Gold charm drifts away, stable face and title. SFX: incoming low rush, wet catching THWUMP, huge circular whoosh, dominant foamy reversal BOOM, clean receding swish, title slam, tiny final drip. No floor, puddle plane, cleaning-room backdrop, speech or music.
